head: beb67ff42a4f862398535bee85a6bada004b377a
summary: Attempt 1's work was unreviewed but sound: it built clean, and its read and tests all passed. I kept it. I added what was missing: the design record `docs/design/SL-111-not-listed-below.md`, and a closed-grammar corpus for the Kind-byte marker class (O-015) that replaces the dropped fitness rule. `ScanStore.NotListedAtOrBelow` follows the last-folder chain over the marks and allocates nothing. The full suite passes 1088 of 1088 (1023 at baseline). Real scans of `C:\Program Files\dotnet` and `C:\Windows\System32`, stopped at 56 moments, matched a full walk with 0 differences. The published App also ran to a Finished ending on the repo's `src` folder.

files.why: Added the public read NotListedAtOrBelow(int) beside NotListed. Its doc comment states the contract, the depth-first/one-block-per-folder dependency, and the RootUnreadable case. The class remarks gained one sentence.

The Walked oracle, RaggedTree and RaggedOrder, the DepthFirstViolation pin, the stop-at-every-call sweeps over the sweep tree and the ragged tree, the traversal pin on completed scans, and the queue, interleave and first-first replays with a last-first control.

SweepTree, SweepOrder, Store, Baseline, Options, RunBaseline and StopAt are now internal so the new tests share them. NotListedAtOrBelow-false is asserted after a completed scan and after a Stop in the size probes.
New Fact for the 5,000,000-entry stopped-late store with a 100,000-child folder: sort plus every row's answer under 250 ms per pass.
The read is asked of all 4,879,990 entries before `retained` is measured. It must allocate under 64 KiB, return exactly 60,002 trues, and read false for each top folder.
The corpus for O-015: 38 refused marker-write spellings, 3 pinned misses and 14 quiet or boundary rows, each with what the dropped patterns did with it.
A closed grammar over src/FsAnalyser.Core/Store/**/*.cs, a census requiring exactly one whole Kind write, and a theory over every corpus row.
The design record: contract, derivation, depth-first-only validity, the Kind-bit masking sites, the alternatives and their costs, measured figures, tests and their gaps, and the decisions taken.

mandatory.where: NotListedBelowTests.CancelAtAnyCallOfTheSweepTreeAnswersAsAWalk and ...OfTheRaggedTreeAnswersAsAWalk (before and during every guarded call, every entry against Walked). Real C:\Program Files\dotnet and C:\Windows\System32 scans stopped at 56 moments: 0 differences.

NotListedBelowTests.TheScannerRegistersFoldersDepthFirstInListingOrder (FolderEnds against RaggedOrder and SweepOrder, plus DepthFirstViolation). AQueueOrderedStoreBreaksTheAnswerAndTheGuardSeesIt and AParallelOrderedStoreBreaksTheAnswerAndTheGuardSeesIt (queue, two-at-a-time, first-first). A last-first control gives 0 differing states and reproduces the scanner's store entry for entry.

ScanStoreRollupTimingTests.AnsweringEveryRowOfAHundredThousandChildFolderInAStoppedFiveMillionStoreFitsTheBudget. Debug: slowest pass 42.4 ms (answers alone 18.5 ms) against 250 ms, first pass cold, exactly 5,000,000 entries.

NotListedTests.ACompletedScanLeavesNothingNotListed (AssertNothingNotListed now asserts NotListedAtOrBelow false for every entry), NotListedBelowTests.TheScannerRegistersFoldersDepthFirstInListingOrder (ragged and sweep trees), and NotListedTests.AStopDuringSizingLeavesEveryFolderListed.

NotListedBudgetTests.AStoreStoppedAtItsUnlistedPeakFitsTheBudget. The read of all 4,879,990 entries allocated 0 bytes, 60,002 entries read true, and retained 637.1 MiB with peak 653.6 MiB against 800 MiB, unchanged. No Append, SetChildren or column change.

obligations.how: The sweep over SweepTree stops before and during every guarded call, including those inside big's multi-buffer listing. It requires at least big's buffer count of such stops, and big and the root must read true there.
The same sweep skips only the first two calls (Count 0, counted and asserted to be exactly 2). It requires at least 4 stops that leave the root NotListed, and the root must read true.
The ragged-tree sweep requires a stop that leaves c2111 NotListed under listed c, c2, c21 and c211. Each of those four must read true.

The ragged-tree sweep meets a with a2 unlisted at least once, where it must read true, and with a2 listed at least once, where it must read false. It also requires a listed folder reading false under a root that still reads true.

RaggedTree has a junction (c\zj) after c's last subfolder and files after the last subfolder in the root's and e's blocks. The backward scan skips them; every Link reads false and a store holding one was met.

The sweep-tree sweep covers the empty folder, the denied folder and m with its only subfolder m\Layers committed NotScanned. It requires at least one stop where Layers and m read false. A file or link reading true fails AssertAnswersAsAWalk.
TheScannerRegistersFoldersDepthFirstInListingOrder: completed real scans of both trees, FolderEnds against RaggedOrder and SweepOrder, and DepthFirstViolation null.

AQueueOrderedStoreBreaksTheAnswerAndTheGuardSeesIt: the last-first control has 0 differing states and equals the scanned store. The queue replay has at least one differing state and DepthFirstViolation is non-null. Mutation check: taking the first folder child instead of the last fails this test and the sweeps.
AParallelOrderedStoreBreaksTheAnswerAndTheGuardSeesIt: the two-at-a-time and first-first replays each need at least one differing state and a firing pin.

The ScanStoreRollupTimingTests Fact builds the exact shape: 5,000,000 entries, S with 100,000 children, 10,000 chains 48 deep, the last chain half listed. It asserts exactly one NotListed entry and exactly one true row per pass, over 10 passes with the first cold. The slowest pass was 42.4 ms.

ACompletedScanLeavesNothingNotListed (sweep tree and long-path/junction tree) and TheScannerRegistersFoldersDepthFirstInListingOrder (sweep and ragged trees) assert NotListedAtOrBelow false for every entry.
AStopDuringSizingLeavesEveryFolderListed now also asserts NotListedAtOrBelow false for every entry of the Cancelled store.

NotListedBudgetTests reads every entry before `retained` is measured: 0 bytes allocated (bound 64 KiB), 60,002 true, each top folder false, and retained, peak and commit still within 800/800/1,024 MiB.

Not handed to this stage; it is owed to validate-slice. The order is guarded by TheScannerRegistersFoldersDepthFirstInListingOrder, the sweeps and the replays, and recorded in the design doc and the NotListedAtOrBelow doc comment.

Took the disposition's drop: nothing in .taad/fitness.yaml changed, so no Q-027 run is needed. The class is closed by KindByteWriteCorpusTests, a closed grammar over Store/**/*.cs. The corpus enumerates 38 refused spellings (+=, -=, helper-returned values, aliases, ref, Span and Unsafe, receiver variants and others), 3 pinned misses and 14 quiet or boundary rows. Its 'before' column shows the dropped patterns firing on 9 refused rows and missing 29. All 57 corpus and census tests pass. With `page.Kind[i] += 0;` planted in ScanStore.cs, the census fails. The spellings are also listed in the design doc beside the masking sites.

NotListed's Options and StopAt are internal, and the sweep-tree theory stops through NotListedTests.StopAt, so m\Layers is planted. It asserts at least one stop sees Layers committed as NotScanned and reading false. Mutation check: replacing StopAt with default options fails the theory with 'no stop saw the container layer store committed as not scanned'.

mutation.replace: ScanResult result = Scans.RunCancellingAt(tree.Root, k, duringTheCall, (root, ct) => Scanner.Scan(root, new ScanProgress(), ct));

obligations.not_mutable: A wording fix in the NotListedAtOrBelow doc comment and in the design doc's contract. Nothing a test can observe changes. Behaviour for a RootUnreadable root (true) follows NotListed and is covered by the root-stop sweeps.
obligations.how: The doc comment says false for every file and link and for every entry once a scan has Completed or was stopped in the size probes, and that a root picked, opened and listed nothing still reads true like NotListed. The same wording is in docs/design/SL-111-not-listed-below.md.

deviations: Design says add a Kind-byte fitness rule. Review m1 (accepted-pending) overrode that: no .taad/fitness.yaml change, so no Q-027 rules-harness run. The marker class (O-015) is held by a test-backed closed-grammar corpus instead, because O-015 requires a corpus whose rows pass. The design doc lists the spellings the grammar cannot see.

Design says the criterion-1 sweep stops through Scans.RunCancellingAt. Per m2, the sweep-tree theory stops through NotListedTests.StopAt, so m\Layers is planted, and asserts a NotScanned Layers stop. Options and StopAt are made internal alongside the other fixtures.

Design says the criterion-5 test builds no oracle array. It builds none. The allocation counter is read after one warm-up call, and the bound is 64 KiB rather than exactly 0; the measured figure was 0 bytes.

Design says the read goes over 'the page arrays'. Per m4 (waived to SC-395), the backward scan looks up each entry's page on its own (_pages[c >> PageShift]) so a block straddling a page boundary reads the right page. The straddling-block Fact itself is not built, as waived.

The m5 loop-termination guard (throw if a chain step does not move forward) and the m6 comment-only notes at Scanner._pending and FolderDone were waived to SC-396 and SC-397 and are not built. Scanner.cs is untouched.
not_built: The architecture rule 'the store writes the Kind byte whole' in .taad/fitness.yaml: dropped by review m1's disposition and replaced by KindByteWriteCorpusTests and its corpus.

A 100,000-entry on-disk fixture for a Stop inside a real folder listing (C-014, material:false in the design): not worth 28-30 s against Q-222's 120 s cap. The multi-buffer 'big' folder takes the same branch, and the real-scan run below also covered Stops mid-listing.
The straddling-page Fact (m4, waived to SC-395), the forward-progress throw (m5, waived to SC-396), and the Scanner.cs comments (m6, waived to SC-397).
No App wiring: FolderTreeNode and the row text are untouched, so T-003 and the window cases and WindowMutants are not in play. Showing the answer on stopped-tree rows is filed for the next slice.

tests.note: First thing run on the inherited tree: 0 warnings, 0 errors.
1088 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (baseline 1023; the 65 new tests are the sweeps, pins, replays, timing and corpus).

Stopped-peak store: read of all 4,879,990 entries 94.7 ms, 0 bytes allocated, 60,002 true, retained 637.1 MiB, peak 653.6 MiB, commit 694.1 MiB. 5M timing test: passes 38.3-42.4 ms (answers alone 16.1-18.5 ms) against 250 ms.
57 passed (55 corpus rows plus the census and the corpus-shape Fact).

tests.command: mutation: first folder child instead of last in NotListedAtOrBelow, run NotListedBelowTests
tests.note: Expected red: 6 of 9 failed (both sweeps, queue and parallel guards). Reverted.

tests.command: mutation: stop after one chain step, run the ragged sweep
tests.note: Expected red: a\a1 reads False, a walk says True. Reverted.

tests.command: mutation: page.Kind[i] += 0; planted in Append, run KindByteWriteCorpusTests.NothingInTheStoreWritesAMarkerIntoTheKindByte
mutation: sweep theory stops with default options (no m\Layers planted)
tests.note: Expected red: 'no stop saw the container layer store committed as not scanned'. Reverted; the 66 NotListedBelow, KindByteWrite and timing tests pass again.

tests.command: PowerShell: Add-Type the built FsAnalyser.Core.dll, Scanner.Scan over C:\Program Files\dotnet and C:\Windows\System32 with CancelAfter at 27 random or small moments each plus an uncancelled run, every entry's NotListedAtOrBelow compared with a full walk
tests.note: 56 of 56 runs with DIFFS=0 (13,002 and 26,170 entries; stops left 6 to 349 unlisted folders, and later stops landed in sizing with none). Real Completed scans read false everywhere.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 publish src/FsAnalyser.App/FsAnalyser.App.csproj -c Release -o artifacts/publish; pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/read-window.ps1 -Root <worktree>\src
tests.note: EXIT 0, report schema 1, 'Finished', 520 files and 44 folders. The App has no consumer of the new read, so this shows only that the shipped exe still scans with the changed Core. artifacts/ is gitignored; no App process was left, and %TEMP%\fsa-tests is empty.

follow_ups: Show the subtree-unread answer on stopped-tree and stopped-list rows in the App (FolderTreeNode and row text), with the window cases, T-003 (red at HEAD) and Q-114's WindowMutants run for an App diff.

Before any pause/resume, read-ahead, block-wise flush or parallel-listing slice changes registration, it must keep depth-first preorder with one SetChildren per whole block (and add a sweep folder larger than one flush block), or replace NotListedAtOrBelow with a stored pending-subfolder count and a 5M memory test. SC-395 (page-straddling block), SC-396 (forward-progress throw) and SC-397 (comments at Scanner._pending and FolderDone) carry the waived findings.
